STEP 1 - Scene: A snack-style plate of cut cantaloupe (orange-fleshed melon) pieces on a white square plate, photographed from above at a near-overhead angle.

STEP 2 - Ruler: White square plate, roughly 22 cm across the diagonal-free side width (the plate's flat edge looks about 20-22 cm). Using ~21 cm diameter equivalent: area = 3.14 x (10.5)^2 ≈ 346 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: Cantaloupe/melon pieces only (about 9-10 wedge and cube pieces). No sauce or oil visible.

STEP 4 - Area: Melon pieces together cover roughly 20% of the plate area (about 70 cm²), spread across the center-right of the plate.

STEP 5 - Volume: Each piece is roughly 3-4 cm long, 2 cm wide, 1.5-2 cm thick. Pile envelope ≈ 70 cm² x 1.8 cm ≈ 125 ml gross.

STEP 6 - Grams: 125 ml x 0.6 g/ml (cut fruit) ≈ 75 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Cantaloupe ≈ 34 kcal per 100 g. 75 g x 34 kcal/100 g ≈ 26 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 10 small melon pieces totaling ~75 g is plausible for a small fruit portion sparsely covering the plate. Energy of ~25 kcal is consistent with low-calorie melon.
